description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'CurrentWeatherFragment' class, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying current weather information, handling user interactions such as refresh and favorite toggling, and observing data from 'WeatherViewModel'.

classes.name: CurrentWeatherFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays current weather data, allowing refresh and favorite toggling, and observing live data from the WeatherViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout for the current weather display.

methods.name: onViewCreated

methods.name: setupSwipeRefresh
methods.description: Configures swipe-to-refresh behavior to trigger data refresh.

methods.description: Sets the click listener for the favorite toggle button.

methods.name: observeWeatherData
methods.description: Subscribes to LiveData objects in the ViewModel to update UI accordingly.
